caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall-mounted object resembling a clock or decorative wall fixture, centered on a plain beige background. The structure is crafted from light brown wood with visible grain, and features ornate, symmetrical carvings on both the lower front panel and the top section. The top portion includes a decorative arch with two arrow-shaped motifs set like clock hands. Below this, there is a zigzag trim that borders a rectangular panel, which displays a floral pattern featuring green leaves and various flowers in shades of yellow, pink, and orange. The sides of the object are extended and slightly raised, adding depth and framing the central floral panel. The entire piece appears to be a carefully constructed and adorned craft object. In the bottom right corner, the name "McCollum" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Comb and Brush Case
